about: Intended exceptions to scripts/lint/crisp.mjs. Each one is listed in the crispness PRs so Dev can keep or remove it. Everything else that blurs, fades or smears is a bug.

blur.reason: Seller (and shared buyer) tab bar glass: Dev's reference mechanism, never touched by this pass.

glass.reason: Seller tab bar capsule glass (noBlur): part of the swipe + glow mechanism.

blur.reason: The glass primitive itself (iOS/Android blur + web backdrop-filter). Only reached by the allow-listed floating controls below; everything else passes `solid`.

glass.reason: BRANDTHREAD_DESIGN.md 'Glass': circular back/share/close floating over photos and video.
IconButton variant='glass': documented for circular controls floating over full-bleed photo/video only.
Circular close/share buttons floating over the full-screen AI result photo.
Live video overlays: host pill, Follow chip, join/purchase event pills (noBlur) and the right-rail circles. Over live video. Dev decides: keep glass, or solid #1C1C1E.
LIVE pill over the playing feed video (noBlur: tint only, no blur). Dev decides.
Shop tag pill over the playing feed video (noBlur: tint only, no blur). Dev decides.

blur.reason: 'Blur' is a background the user picks for their own cut-out photo (content, not UI chrome). Owned by the Remove Background session.
